Request.send. The problem with this approach is that hooks and auth
callables need to be aware of the eager encoding, and if they touch the
originals, make sure to update the encoded versions.

way, hooks and auth callables can safely make changes without fear of
the old, encoded variant overriding it.

causeOfDeath: Fix malformed value parsing for Content-Type (#7309)

pr.excerpt: This PR addresses https://github.com/psf/requests/issues/6646 by cleaning up `_parse_content_type_header`. Instead of setting a default that we can't use in practice, we now skip value assignment completely if the value is malformed. Every RFC from 1521 to 9110 is clear that an `=` is required for a valid parameter. If it doesn't exist, we need to ignore it.
pr.title: Fix malformed value parsing for Content-Type
